**Finding: COMPLIANT** (meets the preferred position) — no redline proposed.

**Why:**
- **No take-or-pay anywhere.** Section 5 (Fees and Payment, p0023) is a pure revenue-share — Kubient contracts with Advertisers and remits AP's share within seven days of receipt. AP owes no fees at all beyond applicable sales/use taxes, so there is no spend obligation capable of triggering a shortfall.
- **No volume restriction on us.** Section 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims exclusivity and confirms AP may offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties — no volume cap, no channel lock-in.
- **The "minimum" hits are benign.** The floor price in the "Winning Bid Price" definition (p0014) is set *by AP* and benefits us; Kubient's disclaimer of guaranteed minimum revenue (p0062) is a warranty disclaimer, not a commitment binding AP.

**Noted in the rationale, not flagged here:** the one-year Initial Term has no convenience-termination right, and Kubient retains fees generated during any termination notice period (p0016). That is a term/termination point rather than a purchase commitment — no spend obligation attaches to it — so it belongs to the termination rule and I have not double-flagged it under MINCOMMIT.
